{{Otheruses|Firespray}}
The '''firespray module''' was a form of [[DarkStryder technology]] that was powered by the intense energies contained in the [[Lifewell]]. When activated, the firespray module emitted a fan of [[Color/Legends|green]] flame which could burn anything it its path. Like most DarkStryder technology, though, the firespray module was only usable in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]]. Any attempt to remove it from the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] and use it would result in the destruction of the module.
